purpose: Verify Faculty can create and publish department announcements.
preconditions: Faculty user is authenticated in CSE department.
action_or_input: Faculty posts announcement with title, content, target_role=ALL, target_program=ALL, target_year=0.
expected_result: Announcement is created in active state with publication timestamp.

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin can create and publish department announcements.
preconditions: Dept_Admin user is authenticated in CSE department.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin posts announcement with title, content, target_role=STUDENT, target_program=BTech, target_year=2.
expected_result: Announcement is created in active state.

purpose: Verify HOD can create and publish department announcements.
preconditions: HOD user is authenticated in CSE department.
action_or_input: HOD posts announcement with title, content, target_role=FACULTY, target_program=ALL, target_year=0.
expected_result: Announcement is created in active state.

purpose: Verify Student is denied from creating announcements.
action_or_input: Student attempts to post announcement.
expected_result: Action is refused (403 Forbidden) and no announcement is created.

purpose: Verify relevant Students and Faculty receive notification when a new announcement is published.
preconditions: Announcement created with target_role=STUDENT, target_program=BTech, target_year=3.
action_or_input: System publishes the targeted announcement.
expected_result: Notification dispatch event or record is generated for targeted users.

purpose: Verify announcement publication with full targeting scope criteria.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin creates announcement targeting role=STUDENT, program=BTech, academic_year=4.
expected_result: Announcement is saved with exact targeting parameters.

purpose: Verify announcement visibility filter matches viewer role, program, and academic year.
preconditions: Announcements A (target: STUDENT/BTech/2) and B (target: FACULTY/ALL/0) exist.
action_or_input: BTech 2nd year Student queries announcement list.
expected_result: Only Announcement A is returned; Announcement B is filtered out.

purpose: Verify authenticated department user views all announcements relevant to them.
preconditions: Announcement C targeting ALL roles in department CSE exists.
action_or_input: CSE Faculty requests announcement list.
expected_result: Announcement C is included in the response.

purpose: Verify that out-of-scope announcements are not visible to users with non-matching program/year.
preconditions: Announcement D targeting MTech year 1 exists.
action_or_input: BTech year 3 student requests announcement list.
expected_result: Announcement D is not returned in results.

purpose: Verify HOD can edit any active department announcement.
preconditions: Active announcement created by Faculty exists.
action_or_input: HOD updates announcement title and content.
expected_result: Announcement content is updated successfully.

purpose: Verify HOD can hide an active department announcement.
preconditions: Active announcement exists and is visible.
action_or_input: HOD sets status to HIDDEN or calls hide action.
expected_result: Announcement is hidden and no longer visible to normal users.

purpose: Verify HOD can delete an active department announcement.
action_or_input: HOD deletes announcement.
expected_result: Announcement is removed or marked deleted, and no longer appears in listings.

purpose: Verify non-HOD actor cannot edit, hide, or delete announcements.
preconditions: Active announcement exists. Student and Faculty users authenticated.
action_or_input: Faculty attempts to delete announcement.
expected_result: Request is refused (403 Forbidden) and announcement remains active.

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin can insert stock records into department inventory.
preconditions: Dept_Admin is authenticated in CSE department.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin adds item 'Microcontroller Kit', quantity=25, location='Lab 101'.
expected_result: Inventory item is created with initial quantity 25.

purpose: Verify system maintains current inventory state and available quantity.
action_or_input: Query inventory list for CSE department.
expected_result: Returns current quantity=25 and active state.

purpose: Verify stock insertion creates an entry in immutable stock-movement log.
action_or_input: Query stock movement logs.
expected_result: Movement log records action INSERT, quantity=10, timestamp, and actor Dept_Admin.

purpose: Verify inventory records and movement audit trails cannot be altered by normal operations.
action_or_input: Attempt update or delete on movement log endpoint.
expected_result: Action is refused (405 Method Not Allowed or 403 Forbidden).

purpose: Verify Faculty can submit stock request for department inventory items.
preconditions: Faculty authenticated, inventory item has available quantity 10.
action_or_input: Faculty submits request for quantity=3 with purpose 'Project'.
expected_result: Stock request created in 'PENDING_HOD' status.

purpose: Verify requested quantity is validated against current inventory at submission.
action_or_input: Faculty requests quantity=5.
expected_result: Request accepted and advances to Pending HOD Approval.

purpose: Verify requested quantity exceeding available inventory is rejected at submission.
action_or_input: Faculty requests quantity=6.
expected_result: Request refused (400 Bad Request) and not advanced to HOD approval.

purpose: Verify HOD can approve a pending Faculty stock request.
preconditions: Stock request is in 'PENDING_HOD' state. HOD is authenticated.
action_or_input: HOD calls approve on the stock request.
expected_result: Request transitions to 'APPROVED_FOR_ISSUANCE'.

purpose: Verify HOD can reject a pending Faculty stock request.
preconditions: Stock request is in 'PENDING_HOD' state. HOD is authenticated.
action_or_input: HOD calls reject on the stock request with remarks.
expected_result: Request transitions to 'REJECTED' state.

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin can issue stock for HOD-approved request.
preconditions: Stock request is in 'APPROVED_FOR_ISSUANCE'. Dept_Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin marks request as issued.
expected_result: Request transitions to 'ISSUED'.

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin cannot issue stock for request that is not approved by HOD.
preconditions: Stock request is in 'PENDING_HOD'. Dept_Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin attempts to mark request as issued.
expected_result: Request is refused (400 Bad Request or 409 Conflict) and remains unissued.

purpose: Verify inventory quantity automatically decrements when approved stock is issued.
preconditions: Item initial quantity=10. Approved request for quantity=3.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin issues the request.
expected_result: Inventory quantity becomes 7.

purpose: Verify stock issuance creates immutable movement log entry.
preconditions: Stock request for quantity=3 is issued.
action_or_input: Query stock movement logs.
expected_result: Log contains entry with action ISSUE, quantity=3, actor Dept_Admin.

purpose: Verify system notifies Dept_Admin when new stock request is submitted.
action_or_input: Check notification dispatches.
expected_result: Notification sent to Dept_Admin for new request.

purpose: Verify system notifies HOD when stock request requires HOD authorization.
action_or_input: Check notification dispatches.
expected_result: Notification sent to HOD.

purpose: Verify system notifies requesting Faculty when stock request reaches Issued or Rejected outcome.
preconditions: Request is rejected by HOD or issued by Dept_Admin.
action_or_input: Outcome action executed.
expected_result: Notification sent to requesting Faculty.

purpose: Verify full lifecycle of stock request from creation to final outcome.
action_or_input: Faculty requests -> HOD approves -> Dept_Admin issues.
expected_result: Status progresses through PENDING_HOD -> APPROVED_FOR_ISSUANCE -> ISSUED.

purpose: Verify Faculty can view their own relevant issued-stock history.
preconditions: Faculty A has issued request; Faculty B has issued request.
action_or_input: Faculty A requests their stock history.
expected_result: Faculty A sees their own issued stock history, excluding Faculty B's records.

purpose: Verify unauthorized user cannot access other faculty members' issued-stock history.
action_or_input: Student attempts to access faculty issued-stock history.
expected_result: Access is refused (403 Forbidden).

purpose: Verify Student can submit department feedback.
preconditions: Student is authenticated in CSE department.
action_or_input: Student posts feedback with title, description, category='ACADEMIC'.
expected_result: Feedback is created in 'NEW' status.

purpose: Verify Faculty can submit department feedback.
preconditions: Faculty is authenticated in CSE department.
action_or_input: Faculty posts feedback with title, description, category='FACILITY'.
expected_result: Feedback is created in 'NEW' status.

purpose: Verify submitted feedback is confidential and inaccessible to unauthorized department users.
action_or_input: Student B attempts to view Student A's feedback.
expected_result: Access is refused (403 Forbidden or 404 Not Found) and feedback is not disclosed.

purpose: Verify system notifies Dept_Admin when new feedback is submitted.
action_or_input: Check notification logs/dispatches.
expected_result: Notification generated for Dept_Admin.

purpose: Verify feedback submission creates initial New record with confidentiality flags.
action_or_input: Submit feedback payload.
expected_result: Created with status NEW, Dept_Admin notified.

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin can perform initial review of newly submitted feedback.
preconditions: Feedback is in 'NEW' status. Dept_Admin authenticated.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin reviews feedback and updates status to 'UNDER_REVIEW'.
expected_result: Feedback status updated to 'UNDER_REVIEW'.

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin can categorize feedback during initial review.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin assigns category 'INFRASTRUCTURE' during review.
expected_result: Feedback category updated to 'INFRASTRUCTURE'.

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin can close a simple feedback issue during initial review.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin marks feedback as 'CLOSED' with resolution remarks.
expected_result: Feedback status becomes 'CLOSED'.

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin can mark feedback as Resolved.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin sets status to 'RESOLVED' with notes.
expected_result: Feedback status becomes 'RESOLVED'.

purpose: Verify HOD can mark feedback as Resolved.
action_or_input: HOD sets status to 'RESOLVED'.
expected_result: Feedback status becomes 'RESOLVED'.

purpose: Verify HOD can access feedback after initial review for oversight and resolution.
action_or_input: HOD retrieves feedback details and oversight queue.
expected_result: Feedback details accessible to HOD.

purpose: Verify system notifies feedback submitter when feedback is marked Resolved or Closed.
action_or_input: Terminal status transition executed.
expected_result: Notification dispatched to submitter.

purpose: Verify unauthorized user cannot perform feedback review or disposition.
action_or_input: Student attempts to close or resolve feedback.
expected_result: Action refused (403 Forbidden).

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin can manage Faculty, Student, and Alumni profile records.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin updates profile details (e.g. office_location, bio, research_interests).
expected_result: Profile is updated successfully.

purpose: Verify non-admin cannot modify department user profiles.
action_or_input: Student attempts to update another user's profile.
expected_result: Action refused (403 Forbidden).

purpose: Verify Students can view only basic permitted profile information for peers and Faculty.
action_or_input: Student views peer or faculty profile.
expected_result: Basic fields (name, email, role, department) returned; sensitive fields masked.

purpose: Verify Faculty can view detailed profile information for Students in their courses.
preconditions: Student is enrolled in Faculty course.
action_or_input: Faculty requests student profile with course relationship.
expected_result: Detailed academic profile information returned.

purpose: Verify Faculty can view permitted limited-scope profile info for Faculty and Alumni.
preconditions: Faculty queries faculty or alumni profile.
action_or_input: Faculty views peer profile.
expected_result: Limited-scope profile information returned; sensitive fields excluded.

purpose: Verify HOD and Dept_Admin view full profiles except privacy-protected sensitive data.
action_or_input: Requests department user profile.
expected_result: Full administrative profile returned; phone/emergency contacts protected per privacy policy.

purpose: Verify profile visibility matrix enforcement across roles.
action_or_input: Different actors query same profile.
expected_result: Response fields adapt strictly according to viewer role and relationship.

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin can upload class and lab timetables.
preconditions: Dept_Admin authenticated. Slot data has no conflicts.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin uploads new timetable entries.
expected_result: Timetable entries saved successfully.

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin can modify existing class and lab timetables.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin updates room or instructor for non-overlapping slot.
expected_result: Timetable modification saved successfully.

purpose: Verify system detects overlapping timetable slots and blocks saving.
preconditions: Timetable slot exists for Room L101 on Monday 10:00-11:00.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin attempts to add overlapping slot in Room L101 on Monday 10:30-11:30.
expected_result: Save is blocked (400 Bad Request or 409 Conflict) and conflict details returned.

purpose: Verify conflict-free timetable upload and modification workflow.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin submits schedule.
expected_result: Schedule saved without errors.

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin can update department lab equipment and resource profile details.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin updates lab capacity, equipment list, and supervisor.
expected_result: Lab resource profile updated successfully.

purpose: Verify Faculty can view department lab resource profiles for planning.
action_or_input: Faculty requests lab resource profiles.
expected_result: Lab details, equipment list, and availability returned.

purpose: Verify non-admin cannot modify lab resource profiles.
action_or_input: Faculty attempts to update lab resource profile.
expected_result: Action refused (403 Forbidden).

purpose: Verify Students can view department academic program information.
action_or_input: Student requests department academic programs list.
expected_result: Academic program details (degree, curriculum, credits) returned.

purpose: Verify Students can view applicable class/lab timetable information.
preconditions: Timetable entries published for BTech program.
action_or_input: Student queries timetable for their program and semester.
expected_result: Applicable schedule grid returned.

purpose: Verify student academic program and timetable views are read-only.
action_or_input: Student attempts to modify timetable or program information.
expected_result: Action refused (403 Forbidden or 405 Method Not Allowed).

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin can update general department information.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin updates description, contact_email, website.
expected_result: General department information updated immediately.

purpose: Verify non-admin cannot update general department info.
action_or_input: Faculty attempts to update general department information.
expected_result: Action refused (403 Forbidden).

purpose: Verify proposed official department-detail change remains pending until HOD approval.
preconditions: Dept_Admin proposes official change (e.g. department name or core policy).
action_or_input: Dept_Admin submits official change proposal.
expected_result: Change created with status 'PENDING_HOD'; live department detail remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify HOD can approve a pending official department-detail change.
preconditions: Official change proposal is in 'PENDING_HOD'. HOD authenticated.
action_or_input: HOD approves the official change proposal.
expected_result: Proposal status becomes 'APPROVED' and department detail updates live.

purpose: Verify HOD can reject a pending official department-detail change.
preconditions: Official change proposal is in 'PENDING_HOD'. HOD authenticated.
action_or_input: HOD rejects the proposal with remarks.
expected_result: Proposal status becomes 'REJECTED' and current department detail is retained.

purpose: Verify Headship identity is excluded from official department-detail proposal path.
preconditions: Dept_Admin attempts to propose official change.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin attempts to change Headship identity via official detail proposal.
expected_result: Field is rejected as non-editable in this path.

purpose: Verify Central Institute Admin can assign Dept_Admin and HOD roles.
preconditions: Institute Admin authenticated. Target employee exists.
action_or_input: Institute Admin assigns HOD role to employee for validity period.
expected_result: Role assignment is recorded successfully.

purpose: Verify system maintains time-bounded validity period for HOD and Dept_Admin assignments.
preconditions: Role assignment created with start_date and end_date.
action_or_input: Query role assignment details.
expected_result: Returns effective validity interval.

purpose: Verify outgoing role holder's access is immediately revoked when reassignment takes effect.
action_or_input: Trigger role transition. Outgoing HOD attempts HOD action.
expected_result: Action is refused (403 Forbidden).

purpose: Verify incoming role holder's access is immediately granted when reassignment takes effect.
action_or_input: Trigger role transition. Incoming HOD performs HOD action.
expected_result: Action succeeds.

purpose: Verify system enforces exactly one active HOD role assignment at any time.
preconditions: Department already has an active HOD assignment.
action_or_input: Attempt to create a concurrent active HOD assignment without transition.
expected_result: Creation blocked (400 Bad Request or 409 Conflict) violating uniqueness.

purpose: Verify system enforces exactly one active Dept_Admin role assignment at any time.
preconditions: Department already has an active Dept_Admin assignment.
action_or_input: Attempt to create a concurrent active Dept_Admin assignment without transition.
expected_result: Creation blocked (400 Bad Request or 409 Conflict) violating uniqueness.

purpose: Verify displayed Headship is derived directly from the current active HOD role assignment.
preconditions: Active HOD assignment is User Prof. X.
action_or_input: Query department public details.
expected_result: Displayed Headship identity matches Prof. X.

purpose: Verify non-institute-admin cannot assign department roles.
action_or_input: Attempts to assign HOD or Dept_Admin role.
expected_result: Action refused (403 Forbidden).
